question: Does raw inquiry language add incremental, point-in-time signal for T1/T2 LeadQuality and Lead×Spot matching beyond structured inquiry fields?

blocker.evidence: Repository inquiry schema contains message_length but no raw message text field.

validation.phase_1: Extraction quality against human-reviewed text labels; no conversion target.
validation.phase_2: Incremental predictive ablation vs atomic structured baseline.
validation.independent_confirmation: Required on a new temporal cohort because E030 test is already consumed.

leakage.T1_rule: Only current first inquiry message and information observable at first inquiry score_time.
leakage.T2_rule: Only messages with inquiry_at <= score_time; no future message may enter trajectory.
